_meta.description: Universal scope-control guidance for AI-assisted changes.

principles.label: Use the smallest safe patch
principles.rationale: Small, evidence-linked edits are easier to validate and less likely to create hidden architectural drift.
principles.directive_hint: Patch only the cited target or directly related files unless the evidence proves a wider dependency chain.

principles.label: Do not invent cleanup work
principles.rationale: Broad cleanup from summaries creates noise and can hide the actual evidence-backed task.
principles.directive_hint: Do not refactor unrelated code from broad summaries; derive a concrete target first.
